∃ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 1 < q →
      ∀ (ι : Type u) (S : Finset ι) (χ : ι → DirichletCharacter ℂ q),
        (∀ i ∈ S, (χ i).IsPrimitive) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (K : ι → ℂ),
          ‖Finset.sum S (fun i => K i * (Zeta23.ThmE.NcountL (χ i) t (t + 1) : ℂ))‖ ≤
            A * Real.log ((q : ℝ) * (|t| + 3)) * (Finset.sum S (fun i => ‖K i‖))
